[Trend Position]
· Current price ($78,953.95) above SMA5 ($78,926.84) and SMA20 ($71,067.2): short-term strength, medium-term trend advantage.
· Above SMA100 ($66,193.26) and SMA200 ($69,313.92): maintaining long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (31.0%) + current price level is historically mid-range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (72.6→72.8) + continuing overbought: upward momentum maintained.
· MACD histogram trajectory (786.6963→786.6963) + holding steady: weak trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near upper band $85,367.13) + 40.24% band width: caution for overheating.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($78,248.91): based on pivot and 5-day low.
· Swing resistance ($79,488.17): potential for further upside on breakout.
· Similar 5-day high/low pattern, similar 20-day high/low pattern: potential for range-bound trading.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.36x): decreased confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (uptrend): consider shifting to sell action if support at 78,248.91 breaks.
